note: Every route the clone serves, each mapped exactly once. Re-derived from the router (src/routes.jsx + src/pages/{product,company,content}/routes.jsx); collection routes (news, study, guides, video) are the slugs of src/pages/content/data/*.js. The catch-all fallback is listed separately. The router normalises trailing slashes, so /news and /news/ are one route.

fallback.note: unknown paths and unknown collection slugs render NotBuilt inside the shell; probePath is only used by extraction/measure_sections.mjs
